description: The lockfile pins 1.62.0 and every tag is `v1.62.0-noble` but one: the nightly's full run is in `v1.62.0-next-canary-20260709180306-noble`, a tag the registry carries for a canary built on 2026-07-09, eighteen days before the image of 1.62.0 itself. Canaries carry the version they lead up to, so the tag begins with the release's own, and a reader that took the version off the front, or compared with `startsWith`, would read 1.62.0 and pass. It is the FIRST mention in the LAST file, the flake job below it at the right tag, so a reader that stopped at the first file or took the last mention of each would pass it too. Every text is the reference's with the version moved to 1.62.0.

workflows..github/workflows/ci.yml:
# Playwright's image, mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v<version>-noble, at the lockfile's version.
jobs:
  gates:
    container:
      image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.62.0-noble # the tag before the bump: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.62.0-noble
      options: --user 1001
    steps:
      - run: scripts/nx-verdict npx nx affected -t lint test build check-browsers
  e2e:
    container:
      image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.62.0-noble
      options: --user 1001
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]
    steps:
      - run: scripts/nx-verdict npx nx affected --shard=${{ matrix.shard }}/${{ strategy.job-total }} -t e2e
workflows..github/workflows/e2e-probe.yml:
jobs:
  probe:
    container:
      image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.62.0-noble
      options: --user 1001
    steps:
      - run: npx playwright test "$@"
workflows..github/workflows/nightly.yml:
jobs:
  full:
    container:
      image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.62.0-next-canary-20260709180306-noble
      options: --user 1001
    steps:
      - run: scripts/nx-verdict npx nx run-many -t e2e
  flake:
    container: { image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.62.0-resolute, options: --user 1001 }
  mutation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
